style: Minimalist 1950s mid-century modern UPA animation and screenprint spot illustration, in the breezy graphic spirit of Festive Buffet Cookery, Chatelaine 401 Tested Recipes, and 1950s Charley Harper / Mary Blair / Saul Bass editorial minimalism. Ultra-simple, playful geometric shapes and clean expressive single-weight black ink contours (or lineless flat cutouts) over strictly 2 or 3 flat matte spot-print colors (vermilion coral-red, warm ochre mustard, olive-chartreuse) and black on generous open warm cream paper. Plenty of breathing room and open negative space (40-50% clean cream paper). NO crosshatching, NO dense stippling, NO fussy fine details, NO photorealism, NOT 3D, NOT glossy modern vector gradients. Full-bleed edge-to-edge minimalist illustration: no book pages, no borders, no captions, no words, no text, no labels, no signatures anywhere in the image.

prompts.hero: Minimalist 1950s UPA graphic spot illustration (no text, no people, generous open warm cream background): a clean stylized white oval platter seen slightly from above holding just five bold, simplified twice-baked potato halves—simple russet-ochre boat shapes topped with fluffy cream-and-mustard swirls, a few bold geometric specks of coral-red paprika and tiny olive chive dashes. Above the platter, two ultra-simple tall mid-century brass candlestick silhouettes and one minimal stylized flat coral-red roast turkey silhouette on a clean mustard table mat. Sparse, breezy, iconic 1950s screenprint art with zero clutter and zero crosshatching.
prompts.s1: Minimalist 1950s spot illustration on generous open cream paper: a bold simplified black cast-iron skillet silhouette over two flat coral-red flame triangles, holding a handful of simple brick-red sausage squares and a minimalist wooden spoon, beside one clean small dish of red sausage bits. Zero clutter, zero crosshatching.
prompts.s2: Minimalist 1950s spot illustration on open cream paper: a clean geometric baking sheet with four simple oval russet potatoes and a few bold dots of salt, beside two stylized garlic bulb silhouettes wrapped in simple angular silver-grey foil triangles. Flat screenprint shapes, zero clutter.
prompts.s3: Minimalist 1950s spot illustration on open cream paper: a simple flat saucepan with a playful puff of ochre-gold foam, beside a clean geometric silver box grater and three bold simplified cheese triangles (cream, ochre, pale yellow) with three neat little grated mounds. Breezy mid-century print, zero crosshatching.
